paragraphs.text: The term guildmaster , or guild leader , is used for the people that preside (even if nominally or informally) over one of the Ravnican guilds . A guild's founder and first guildmaster is called its parun .
This is a list of guildmasters and former guildmasters in order of succession.
Borborygmos , the leader of the most powerful clan (informally)
Rakdos (parun); represented by Izolda Lyzolda Exava Hekara
Mat'Selesnya (parun); represented by Chorus of the Conclave The High Council Trostani
